title: Happiness as a Measure of Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The proposed framework and benchmarks measure fairness in terms of a utility-based concept called 'happiness' and compare it to standard fairness metrics like Equalized Odds and Statistical Parity in the context of loan approval and income prediction.
base_benchmarks: Financial Risk for Loan Approval dataset
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
